title: Hallucination
text: I had the Filolial-samas and the others wait in a spot away from town, just as we’d planned, while I popped into a shop in town. It was a restaurant, I believe. Or so I thought—but something seemed off about the town.
Black smoke was rising here and there. Could it be a fire? What a rather unsettling town. With those thoughts in mind, I made my way to the restaurant as planned.
“Excuse me!”
When I went inside, one of them was a pig, so I couldn’t understand what he was saying, but my Father and the others must have spoken to them beforehand. A male clerk showed me to my seat.
“Welcome. That spear… you must be the Spear Hero. This way.”

He wasn’t a Demi-Human—he was human. Is this a shop that’s ostensibly run by humans? With that thought in mind, I headed to the back of the shop. There, I found my father looking a bit worn out, along with Éclair and the envoy from Siltvelt.
“Ah, Lord Kitamura. How are things going?”
“Everything is ready.”
“I see.”
“By the way, the town’s been pretty chaotic for a while now.”
“Ah, I hear there have been arson attacks and disturbances all over town…”
“I know I’ve asked this several times already, but is this the work of the Three Heroes Church, too?”
My Father looked rather apologetic.
“I think so. The town lord is doing his best to put out the fires, but with all the commotion caused by those who claim to be adventurers, the town is on the verge of complete paralysis.”
“What a terrible cult.”

“…Absolutely. There’s a limit to how far extremists can go, after all. I hear the tavern where we stayed before parting ways with Lord Kitamura has been set on fire so many times, no one can even keep track. It’s closed down now.”
That was quite a misfortune.
“This place should probably close down after we leave, too.”
“Yes. We’ve already submitted a claim for compensation.”

The envoy from Siltvelt nods. It’s quite possible that the lot who were probably tailing me got wind of this somewhere. Just as I was thinking that, an adventurer appeared at the shop, shouting the usual “It stinks!” Hmm… I suppose there’s no helping it. I’ll head from the back of the shop toward the front.
“Mr. Kitamura, what are you planning to do?”
“We’ll be moving on soon anyway. I’m just going to teach them a lesson about their own foolishness the hard way while we’re at it.”
“S-someone, stop Motoyasu-kun!”
“Only Father Iwatani can do that!”
My father and Éclair have started arguing about something.
“Motoyasu-kun! Come on, don’t make a bigger fuss than this!”
“Hahaha! You’re so kind, Father. This Motoyasu is moved to tears by your kindness. But that’s a separate matter.”
“I won’t stop! Ms. Eclair!”
“Mr. Kitamura! Please, let’s move on to the next—”

Leaving my kind father behind, I head toward the counter. And there, grinning like an idiot… Oh? There was the guy I’d paralyzed with the Paralyze Lance. The moment he saw my face, his expression turned pale. This is priceless. It must have traumatized him.
“It seems you haven’t learned your lesson.”
“Sh-shut up! So the Shield Demon is here! If I kill you, I’ll rake in the bounty! Right there—”
“You should be grateful for Father’s mercy. Illusion Lance!”
With a swift thrust, I drove the lance right into his forehead once again.
“Gua—”
Thud. As I took out the idiot at the front, the idiots behind him gasped. These guys… well, they’ll do just fine.
“Paralyze Lance! Here we go—!”
“Gyaaaah—Guga—”
He tried to run, so I expanded the hole for him. Hahahahahaha! He’s twitching and convulsing like he’s already done the deed.
“Ha, ha ha… W-with this… I’m… a millionaire! Hahahahahaha!”

The Illusion Lance’s effect is kicking in. He’s all limp, his pupils completely dilated, drooling, and starting to stagger around. So, I kicked him out onto the street in front of the shop, and while I was at it, I tossed out the others I’d paralyzed as well. There were a few guys who looked like they were from the Three Heroes Church standing in front of the shop, but they were speechless when they saw the adventurers coming out. I clapped my hands a couple of times, then headed back into the back of the shop.
“Ah… It’s already too late…”
“What’s the matter?”
“Are you holding back, Lord Kitamura?”
“I’m holding back plenty. If I hadn’t, those guys would be in the afterlife by now.”
“You call that holding back…”
“It would’ve been more merciful to just kill them…”
It seems my father and Éclair are having a private conversation.
“You’d better watch your words, Mr. Iwatani. Mr. Kitamura has a tendency to misinterpret what you say and go off the rails.”
“Yeah. I’ll be as careful as I can.”
Just as we were talking, things started to get noisy. Looking outside, it seemed a scuffle had broken out between the vigilante group and the Three Heroes Church members claiming to be adventurers.
“Don’t you think it’s about time we started moving?”
“Understood.”
With my father leading the way, we sent out a party invitation and then activated the Portal Spear.
In an instant, our field of vision shifted to the mountain path where Filolial-sama and the others were waiting.
“Whoa! That startled me. I’d heard about it, but it really is amazing.”
My father was looking around nervously. The envoy from Siltvelt was doing the same. Perhaps because Éclair has experienced this several times before, she didn’t react all that much.
“Gua!”
Yuki-chan and the others raised their wings to greet us.
“Did they grow this big in just two days?”
“That’s amazing. Do you remember me?”
Father asked Sakura-chan. Sakura-chan then bowed her head slightly in a nod. Then she began rubbing her head against Father’s chest.
“Ahahaha… You’re still cute even though you’ve grown up.”

My father is smiling as he strokes Sakura-chan’s head. What a picturesque scene. This is a side of my father I rarely get to see. I’ll burn this image into my memory. My brain cells have etched the image of my father gently stroking Sakura-chan into my mind.
“What level are you at now?”
“Level 40.”
“40!? Level 40 in just two days!?”
“That’s incredibly fast. Is this normal?”
“It’s an astonishing pace. That’s way beyond the norm, no matter how you look at it!”
The envoys from Éclair and Siltvelt are shocked. But I’m not lying.
“Oh, and here are some souvenirs for you, Father.”
I show them the various materials and dropped weapons I’d been keeping on top of the cart Yuki-chan and the others were pulling.
“What on earth is this!?”
“These are the results of two days’ work. There were actually a lot more, but I just couldn’t fit them all on the cart.”
“Wow… there’s a huge variety of materials here.”
“Please put these into my Father’s shield.”
“I think it’ll say I don’t have enough level or skill tree points for most of them… but okay. I’ll just put in the number needed to meet the unlock requirements.”
My Father starts putting various materials into the shield.
“I’d recommend this sword for Éclair.”
“Mr. Kitamura, I really wish you’d remember my name already… but where’s that sword coming from?”
“Isn’t it that thing? I think it’s a drop from the ‘Power of the Hero’s Weapon’… the one where you have a monster absorb into a weapon to get a different item.”
“That’s right.”

I handed Éclair the sword that dropped when I defeated a monster deep in the mountains—it seemed like a good fit for her. I think the name was Griffin Edge, wasn’t it? It’s not a spear, but a sword modeled after a serrated wing—I don’t think that’ll be a problem. Éclair, having received the sword, is staring intently at the blade and grunting.
“It seems to be quite a fine sword. I feel it might be a bit too much for me, though… I’m worried I won’t be able to make full use of it.”
“I’ve also secured some armor for Father.”
I showed Father the armor that dropped when I defeated a large griffin.
“Ah, thank you… It looks really heavy, though…”
“Come on, Father. Raise your arms. I, Motoyasu, will help you put it on.”
“O-okay.”
I helped my father put on the armor. But then he suddenly toppled forward with a thud?
“It’s… heavy…”
Huh? It seems he didn’t have the required stats to equip it. Oh well. I’ll take the armor off and put it back on the cart.
“We’ll have to level up a bit first.”
“Y-yeah, you’re right. We wouldn’t want the gear Motoyasu-kun went out of his way to prepare to go to waste.”
“We’ve suddenly got a lot more supplies… I think we’ve completely shaken off our pursuers with our teleportation ability… but just to be safe, let’s set out early.”
“Roger that! Come on, everyone! Hop on the cart—we’re setting off!”
“I’d at least like to upgrade the cart to a horse-drawn carriage… but I’ll save that for after we’ve traveled a bit.”
My father-in-law and Éclair climbed onto the cart as if they’d given up on something, and I confirmed that the envoy from Siltvelt had boarded as well.
“Gua!”
I climbed onto the back of Yuki-chan, who serves as Filolial-sama’s representative, and raised my spear.
“Well then, let’s get going!”
“‘Guaa!’”
With a clatter, Filolial-sama and the others set off running! Kicking up a cloud of dust, our journey continues!
